steps.u: The conversion rate on the dashboard dropped from 4.1% to 2.9% on Nov 12. Is it real or a data problem? Query the events in Snowflake.

i.command: snowsql -q "select date(ts) d, count_if(event='purchase')/count_if(event='session_start') r from events where ts >= '2026-11-08' group by 1 order by 1"
snowsql -q "select app_version, date(ts) d, count_if(event='purchase') p, count_if(event='session_start') s from events where date(ts) in ('2026-11-11','2026-11-12') group by 1,2"

steps.a: The drop comes entirely from the new app version 5.4.0 released that day: it has 3100 session starts but only 12 purchases, while 5.3.0 is unchanged at about 4.2%. A purchase rate of 0.4% in one version suggests the purchase event is not firing in 5.4.0 rather than customers buying less. I haven't confirmed that in the app code.

reference.summary: Traced a dashboard conversion rate drop to one app version: the new release has thousands of session starts but almost no purchase events while the previous version is unchanged, which points to a tracking regression rather than a real change. This was not confirmed in the app code.
facts: rate fell from about 4.1% to 2.9% on Nov 12
specific: segmenting a metric by app version
